OpenBottle

a free macOS app for running compatible Windows games without learning Wine first.

download previews source on GitHub
the alpha is still being finished. Preview builds are for testing until they are signed, notarized, and checked across the full game matrix.

how it should feel

1. add a gameUse Steam, an installer, or a copied Whisky bottle.
2. press PlayOpenBottle picks a safe runtime and graphics profile for this Mac.
3. keep the good setupRuntime, configuration, and local save restore points survive updates.

what it uses

OpenBottle builds on Wine and the open DXMT, DXVK, and MoltenVK graphics paths. Apple's D3DMetal can be imported by the user as an optional proprietary component; it is never redistributed with the open runtime.

the compatibility limit

Some Windows games depend on kernel anti-cheat, drivers, DRM, or graphics features that macOS cannot provide. OpenBottle detects known blockers and explains them before launch. Compatibility claims are tied to a tested game, Mac, runtime, and profile.

why this exists

The first real test was Screw Drivers on an M1 Max. A measured DXMT and MetalFX setup made a lower internal resolution look close to the Mac's native panel while keeping latency low. The project is turning that one working experiment into the normal flow for many games.

OpenBottle is GPL-3.0 software derived from Whisky. Wine and every graphics/runtime component keep their own licenses.
